title.en: Batas Pambansa Blg. 451  An Act Converting the Sablig Barangay High School in the Municipality of Anda, Province of Pangasinan, Into a National High School to Be Known as the Anda National High School, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds therefor.

title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Trường Trung học Sablig Barangay tại Thị trấn Anda, Tỉnh Pangasinan thành Trường Trung học Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Anda Quốc gia
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Sablig Barangay ในเทศบาล Anda จังหวัด Pangasinan เป็น โรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาแห่งชาติในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Anda แห่งชาติ
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Sekolah Menengah Sablig Barangay di Kotamadya Anda, Provinsi Pangasinan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Anda Nasional

text.en:
The Sablig Barangay High School in the Municipality of Anda, Province of Pangasinan, is
hereby converted into a national high school to be known as the Anda National High School.

The amount of one hundred thousand pesos for the operation of the school shall be funded out of
the appropriations authorized by Batas Pambansa Bilang 230 for the Ministry of Education, Culture and
Sports intended for new national high schools and an additional amount corresponding to fifty percent of its
share in the budgetary aid actually paid to it before such conversion shall be released for its operation from the
national assistance fund to local schools. Thereafter, such sum as may be necessary for its operation and
maintenance shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 10, 1983
